metadata.coreContent: A yellow can of Squirt Grapefruit Soda covered in condensation droplets, centered against a vibrant yellow and green abstract background with the text 'REFRESHINGLY UNIQUE'.
metadata.style: Vibrant Graphic Illustration, Commercial Advertising, High-Contrast Vector Art
metadata.additionalDetails: Features the text 'REFRESHINGLY UNIQUE' in a bold green font at the top. The can includes the classic red Squirt logo, 'caffeine free', 'Thirst Quencher', and 'Grapefruit Soda' labels, covered in realistic water droplets.

metadata.coreContent: A vintage-style embossed metal sign featuring the classic 'Little Squirt' cartoon mascot hugging a green glass bottle of Squirt soda beneath a yellow 'DRINK Squirt' header.
metadata.style: Studio product photography of a vintage embossed metal sign, clean white background, glossy finish.
metadata.additionalDetails: Features the text 'DRINK Squirt' in stylized red and black lettering on a yellow background at the top, with the mascot 'Little Squirt' holding a green glass bottle with a yellow splash label.

metadata.coreContent: Four 7Up soda cans, featuring two regular Lemon Lime and two Zero Sugar variants, are depicted floating at dynamic angles against a solid, vibrant green background.
metadata.style: Commercial Studio, Vibrant Minimalist, Photorealistic with condensation droplets.
metadata.additionalDetails: The image showcases two standard green 7Up Lemon Lime cans and two dark green/black 7Up Zero Sugar cans. All cans are covered in realistic water droplets to convey coldness and freshness.

metadata.coreContent: Two hands holding up cans of Dr. Pepper and Dr. Pepper Zero Sugar in a toast, set against a blurred football stadium background at night.
metadata.style: Commercial advertising photography with a shallow depth of field, dramatic stadium lighting, and bold graphic overlays.
metadata.additionalDetails: Features the slogan 'IT'S A pepper THING™' with a football graphic, along with the Dr. Pepper and College Football Playoff logos in the bottom right.
